sources.title: Sentinel/redteam/2026-09-03b at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: Red-team round 5 — spelling class round 3 + a dead-telemetry find (2026-09-03b) Round 4 closed the Unicode-dash spelling (F16, engine-side dash fold). This round attacks the next spellings of the same class and re-attacks EXEC-002's telemetry. Everything (scripts, mimic trees, proof files) stayed inside redteam/2026-09-03b/; payloads are Write-Host / echo / Add-Content only.
